bio.text: Debbie Dingell represents Michigan's 6th Congressional District in the U.S. House and serves on the Energy and Commerce and Natural Resources Committees.
Before Congress she worked in the auto industry for over three decades, including as president of the General Motors Foundation, and chaired the Wayne State University Board of Governors.
She holds a B.S.F.S. and an M.S. in liberal studies from Georgetown University and lives in Ann Arbor.
